Region: Canaan (later Arka, on the Phoenician coast, is the common identification)
History: The Arkites are named in the Table of Nations as descendants of Canaan (Genesis 10:17; 1 Chronicles 1:15), with no further biblical history. The later Phoenician coastal town of Arka in northern Lebanon is commonly identified with them, but the text itself does not make that connection.
Culture: Nothing is recorded of Arkite culture beyond their place in the Canaanite family list; the later Arka was a Phoenician coastal town.
Religion: Nothing distinct is recorded of Arkite religion.
BibleConnection: The Arkites appear only in the Table of Nations, one branch of Canaan's family spread abroad after Babel.
